tools.name: ast-grep
tools.description: Structural code search & refactor via AST patterns

manual.notes: Works across 20+ languages via tree-sitter. Patterns look like real code.

tools.name: ripgrep (rg)
tools.description: Blazing-fast recursive grep, used by Claude Code internally

manual.notes: Use -t to filter by language. -i ignore case, -l files only, -A/-B for context.

tools.name: lazygit
tools.description: Terminal UI for git — stage, commit, rebase visually

manual.notes: Keys: space stage, c commit, P push, p pull, b branches.
Set as git's external diff tool to get AST-aware diffs everywhere.

tools.name: git-delta
tools.description: Syntax-highlighted git diff pager with word-level diffs

manual.notes: Add the config block to ~/.gitconfig to enable delta as the default pager.

tools.name: shellcheck
tools.description: Validates shell scripts — catch bugs before they bite

manual.notes: Inline disable comments suppress specific lints on the next line.

tools.name: fzf
tools.description: Fuzzy finder for files, history, branches

manual.notes: Already in apt. Keybindings are set after running fzf install script.

tools.name: tmux
tools.description: Terminal multiplexer — pair Claude with logs/server in panes

manual.notes: Prefix Ctrl+b precedes every command. Detach to keep sessions alive between SSH connects.
Keys: q quit, +/- change update rate, f filter.
Auth once, then PR/issue/repo workflows stay in the terminal.

tools.name: caveman
tools.description: Cuts Claude Code output tokens ~65% — talks like caveman, same accuracy

manual.notes: Modes: lite / full / ultra. Output tokens drop 60-87% depending on mode.

tools.name: zero-native
tools.description: Zig + WebView app framework — what built this app

manual.notes: Engines: system WebView (small binary) or CEF/Chromium (consistent rendering).
